intro.title: Sharps
intro.text: A sharp (♯) raises a note to the very next key on the right. F♯ is the black key just right of F.

intro.title: Flats
intro.text: A flat (♭) lowers a note to the very next key on the left. B♭ is the black key just left of B.

intro.title: Two names, one key
intro.text: C♯ and D♭ are the same black key. Notes like this are “enharmonic”. White keys can do it too: E♯ is F, and C♭ is B.

intro.title: How this drill works
intro.text: A note appears on the staff with its name. Find the key and play it. Only your first answer counts.
